title: Outside bulk mode the list has no checkboxes and a row click opens the part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Make sure bulk mode is off: no dark bar shows on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click part A's description in its row.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the Inactive tab.
  5. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box again.
  6. Click the part B row.
  7. Click Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.
  • There is no checkbox column and no checkbox in the header row, so no part can be ticked.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A: its Part Number field holds part A's part number.
  • Nothing is ticked.

Step 3:

  • The window closes without changes.

Step 4:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 5:

  • Part B is listed, with no checkbox column.

Step 6:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 7:

  • The window closes without changes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S2-N2: “Outside the mode there is no checkbox column, so no part can be ticked from the default list.”
  • Key Decisions: “Bulk status change is a mode. A row click on the Inventory list opens the part. Bulk status uses the same pattern as Cycle count: the user turns the mode on from the actions menu, checkboxes appear, search and filtering keep working, and the X on the bulk bar leaves the mode.”
